readme_excerpt: English | 简体中文 --- QuestDB is the open-source, low-latency time-series database on open formats. It ingests millions of events per second, computes on live data in milliseconds, and keeps years of history queryable. One SQL engine spans ingestion, stream processing, and tiered storage. The engine is zero-GC Java with C++ and Rust on the hot paths. Data lives in memory-mapped, time-partitioned columns. Queries run across all cores with SIMD and JIT-compiled filters. There are no third-party dependencies on the data path. Storage is tiered: a parallel write-ahead log, native columnar partitions, and Apache Parquet. In open source you convert partitions to Parquet with `ALTER TABLE`, or create a table in Parquet directly. QuestDB Enterprise converts cold partitions automatically and tiers them to object storage. Parquet, Apache Iceberg, and Apache Arrow keep the data open to any tool. readme_excerpt: # HFT Limit Order Book Pipeline High-Performance Market-Data Decoder • Lock-Free Concurrency • ClickHouse Ingestion • C++20 This project implements a complete high-performance market-data pipeline that processes Databento DBN MBO data, maintains a real-time limit order book, and streams normalized rows into ClickHouse for downstream analytics. --- ## Overview The system consists of four parallel components: 1. **DataStreamer** Streams DBN files over TCP at high speed using epoll, mmap, and an optional token-bucket rate limiter. 2. **Decoder Thread** Uses the Databento C++ SDK to decode MBO messages and pushes them into a lock-free SPSC queue. 3. **Limit Order Book (LOB) Thread** Maintains the bid/ask books, applies add/cancel/replace events, and periodically emits JSON snapshots. 4. **ClickHouse Writer Thread** Batches updates in chunks of 5000 rows and inserts into ClickHouse asynchronously. Each component runs on an isolated thread and communicates via lock-free ring buffers for maximum throughput. --- ## Architecture ``` DataStreamer (TCP) │ ▼ Decoder Thread (DBN) │ SPSCQueue │ ▼ LOB Thread (Order Book) │ ├───────► JSONL Snapshots ▼ SPSCQueue (batched) │ ▼ ClickHouse Writer Thread ``` --- ## Features
